objective: Generate local counterfactual repairs directly from physically label-free claim/source pairs for later 4-BPE localization.
prohibited_inputs: v1 or v2 repair candidate pools

opcode_rules.algorithm: difflib.SequenceMatcher over normalized lexical tokens with autojunk disabled
opcode_rules.insert_delete_rule: Only one or two frozen negation tokens may be inserted or deleted; negation replacements are rejected.
opcode_rules.coverage_metric: multiset factual-token symmetric F1 between claim and source

type_rules.number: both blocks are numbers of the same frozen subtype
type_rules.temporal: both blocks are dates/months/weekdays/years of the same subtype; modal may is excluded
type_rules.entity: both blocks satisfy the frozen proper-name pattern
type_rules.direction: both blocks form one frozen opposite pair
type_rules.relation: both blocks contain factual lexical content and trigger no typed mismatch

qc.decision: Clear means one minimal, grammatical local edit whose replacement is locally plausible from the displayed source. Full entailment is deferred to NLI.

stop_rule: Stop before NLI if capacity fails or research-agent proxy QC is below threshold. If v3 fails, terminate this rule-based candidate-generation route without changing thresholds or inspecting held-out labels.
next_stage_if_passed: Prepare a resumable paired original/repaired NLI manifest only and wait for the occupied GPU to be released.
